name: Lyric text
description: Draws the lyric layer over the scene. uAmount selects the style: 0 wavy sine (the Amiga scroller look), 1 beat slam, 2 soft fade, 3 horizontal scroll, 4 karaoke word wipe, 5 word-per-beat cascade, 6 spectrum ride, 7 beat shockwave, 8 per-word drift, 9 transient shatter. Director.BuildTexts picks which, from the section's tempo, spectral balance and how fast its words arrive.

cue.description: 0..1 through the current line's lifetime; supplied by the renderer.

beats.description: Beats of the tracked grid since this line started. What the word-per-beat styles step on.

span.description: The whole line's length in beats, so a per-word style can fit its steps inside the line. 0 when nothing is supplying cue timing.

ids.description: 1 when the text raster carries per-word ids in its colour channels. 0 for a plain white raster, where every pixel reads as the first word.
